title: v0.32.8
description: Muse Glimmer Muse Glimmer is now available on all platforms. Muse Glimmer can power coding agent applications such as Claude Code, Codex, Pi and more, as well as long-running personal assistants such as OpenClaw and Hermes. Ollama's MLX engine provides state-of-the-art performance on Apple Silicon for this model, with support for DFlash and image input as of Ollama 0.32.7.
